definitions.explanation: An adverb expressing respect and humility, used when making formal statements, offers, or condolences.

examples.japanese: {謹|つつし}んでお{悔|く}やみ{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
{謹|つつし}んで{新年|しんねん}のお{慶|よろこ}びを{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I respectfully extend New Year's greetings.

examples.japanese: ご{招待|しょうたい}を{謹|つつし}んでお{受|う}けいたします。

notes:
FORMALITY:
This is very formal language used in ceremonial contexts, written correspondence, and official announcements.

COMMON SET PHRASES:
・{謹|つつし}んでお{悔|く}やみ{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます - Please accept my condolences
・{謹|つつし}んで{新年|しんねん}のお{祝|いわ}いを{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます - New Year's greeting
・{謹|つつし}んでお{礼|れい}{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます - I humbly express my gratitude
・{謹|つつし}んでご{報告|ほうこく}いたします - I respectfully report

ETYMOLOGY:
From the verb {謹|つつし}む (to be discreet, to be reverent) in て-form. The kanji {謹|きん} conveys respect and carefulness.
